purpose: Executable bounded channel for native retained construction maps; not yet the proposed114-record esd7 producer.

recordTypes.open: Declare four marked seed vertices, the root reference and its derived context witness. Native rules construct the root packet; no completed assembly is supplied.
recordTypes.begin: Name an ordered history starting at the retained root. Starting another history does not delete any existing records.
recordTypes.execute: Name a unique occurrence, its history and source/target references, a native operation kind and a target context witness. Derive the target, full coefficient permutation and geometric attachment through the native constructor.
recordTypes.witness: Certify an additional native interface between already retained packet references. This is not another executed history event.
recordTypes.compare: Reference two history positions at the same marked chart and origin. Compute, rather than supply, their relative coefficient permutation.
recordTypes.close: List all histories in retained presentation order; require terminal E exits and complete native contact/interface coverage.

invariants: Exactly one opening and one closing record; nothing follows closing.
Occurrence IDs and reference identities are not replaced by equality of displayed values.
Every target and context witness is checked against the existing native rules.
Every retained interface appears as an executed or separately witnessed operation.
Field frame words and five-slot permutations are derived, not copied from target readout matrices.
All histories and the complete serialized record order remain available.
scope: These opening/closing meanings apply to the native fixture. Their identification with the two extra1 records of the global conjecture is not established.
